questionText:
A and B started a business by investing ₹70,000 each. After 10
months, A invests an additional amount of ₹40,000. After 2 more months, B withdraws ₹20,000. After 2 more months, a third person, C joins the business and invests ₹40,000. If at the end of 2 years, C gets ₹7,500 as his share of profit, then what is A's share
in the profit?
